The two-sided η² statistic S = max(η²(ŷ|nf), η²(residual|nf)) catches both shortcut-learning (permutation-drop's home ground) and orthogonal-plant leakage (permutation-drop's blind spot when features cannot encode nf). narrative: Substitution of the brief's vanilla permutation-drop with a two-sided η² statistic (S = max(S_model, S_resid)) is documented in docs/ear_preparation_report.md §4.3 and captured as a canonical decision record in _manager/M-EAR-1-leak-statistic-substitution.md. Rationale: orthogonal-plant leaks (artist round-robin, era sha256 buckets) are unreachable by permutation-drop because the model cannot learn a shortcut through features that do not encode nf; η² on the residual channel catches such plants. Both statistics are scale-free in y_te and bounded in [0,1], so a single τ works across α levels.
